items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: why didn't he say that I jammed with Pres, Lester Young?

ctx.x: Yeah, it had no veracity. If they'd said that I like girls, he had something. If he said that I smoked pot, he had something. I smoked a lot of pot, I loved it. If he said I drank, fine, when I could get ahold of it, yes. This, he had something. This is true.
But to say -- why didn't he say that I jammed with Pres, Lester Young? Why didn't he say that?
You said that he cost you a record date.
